dct_description_sm: Also covers part of eastern Maine.

Also covers part of eastern Maine. Shows "RARE II roadless areas" (recommended wilderness areas, areas for further planning, nonwilderness areas, existing wilderness areas, and other national forest system lands) in color on black-and-white base map. Relief shown by spot heights. In upper right margin: New Hampshire and Vermont. In lower right margin: N.H. and Vt. Base map "Compiled, edited, and published by the Geological Survey." "*U.S. Government Printing Office: 1979--650-772." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
